name: shifteasy
description: Shift management and time tracking for construction teams

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix client ci
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
